chips.title: Implement production audit tiers
chips.summary: Audit selection, queueing, imports, release gates and full audit scheduling are implemented.

evidence.message: Recorded from the implemented plan and its existing acceptance tests.

chips.title: Verify production audit readiness
chips.summary: Check live audit configuration, waiting jobs and release prerequisites; record the next safe activation step.

evidence.message: Selected because the prior handoff reports inactive tiers and waiting imports.
Board and status passed the Dias parsers; live readiness inspection started.
Verified live policy, stored audits and service health; recorded activation prerequisites and the GitLab access failure.

chips.title: Recover GitLab reader access
chips.summary: Diagnose the provider authentication failure and restore reconciliation without hiding route coverage.

evidence.message: Live reconciliation returns HTTP 401 while the worker is running; credential cause is not yet established.
The operator reported saving a replacement after GitLab confirmed that the original reader had expired. Live verification started.
The replacement read the project and pipeline jobs and fetched the branch. GitLab denied the job log because the reader lacks Job Read.
The worker can read the original vault entry only. It restarted on that entry. The operator must save a reader with job log access there.
The operator reported updating the original vault entry. Verification resumed from the worker host.
The worker host read the previously rejected job log and fetched the main branch at the revision reported by GitLab.
Both providers reconciled after the worker restarted. Health reported zero problems and the alert service accepted the resolution.

chips.title: Settle three waiting pull request audits
chips.summary: Review the saved audit packets for three merged pull requests. Import valid reports or record why an obsolete audit was cancelled.

evidence.message: The live queue still has three pull request audits awaiting import after the worker recovered.
Confirmed three prepared attempts and matching checkouts. Began reviewing the saved pull request revisions.
Imported three verified reports with eight findings. Each original revision has one matching GitHub audit check. No audit is waiting for import.

chips.title: Prove the full audit baseline
chips.summary: Run one full repository audit and verify that a later pull request audit uses it as its comparison baseline.

evidence.message: The three completed pull request audits have no comparison baseline. The live store has no full audit.
Confirmed the worker is healthy and the repository has no baseline. Started the full audit and a pull request to verify its use.
The worker completed the scheduled full audit and selects it as the repository baseline. It covers all 117 concepts and records 32 findings.
Pull request 33 used the repository baseline, passed isolated tests and merged. Its change-scoped full audit confirmed the alert fix and preserved the baseline.

chips.title: Enforce host builds, tests and code review on pull requests
chips.summary: Prove the host builds, tests and reviews a real pull request commit. Require its results on GitHub and verify both a blocked merge and a passing merge.

evidence.message: The host passed isolated tests on pull request 33. Claude reported that it was signed out and the worker saved the failed advisory review for operator attention.
The host reviewer is signed in. The live observer omits the package build, advisory review reports neutral, and GitHub has no rules on the default branch.
GitHub refused pull request 35 when both checks were missing. It refused again when the host build passed and code review failed.
The host built, tested and reviewed the exact head of pull request 36. Both App checks passed and GitHub merged it with the branch rules active.

chips.title: Prove that the release audit controls release planning
chips.summary: Use a protected target to show that release planning refuses missing audit evidence and accepts a valid release audit.

evidence.message: The audit baseline and protected pull request workflow are operational. The roadmap still calls for a live release gate demonstration.
Confirmed the target is protected. Preparing the trusted evidence workflow and a policy with release audits enabled.
Release planning refused the reviewed and merged candidate because its release audit was missing. The worker queued the audit and saved no release request.
A live comparison reproduced the saved review after the target advanced. The release audit and the native workflow permission still need verification.

chips.title: Fix and retry pull request checks
chips.summary: Limit GitHub requests during review, fix the Windows recovery failure and verify both checks on a real pull request.

evidence.message: Pull request review found unbounded comparison requests. A Windows recovery test lost its claim while saving a report.
Started regression checks for comparison requests and Windows recovery after the board files passed validation.
Pull requests 37 and 38 merged. The deployed fix passed isolated builds and real code review on pull request 38. Both Windows versions passed.

chips.title: Resolve the production audit findings
chips.summary: Recheck the full audit and fix outstanding issues in worker reliability, state access, deployment and recovery. Verify each result.

evidence.message: The full audit reported 32 findings. A later audit confirmed the missing alert credential fix and listed 31 open findings.
Rechecked the baseline and began examining the outstanding deployment, recovery, data and worker findings.
An encrypted backup restored all 321 signed receipts. The live baseline query uses its verified index. The locked observer passed the host deployment suite.
The rollout exposed a worker readiness failure under the credential launcher. The fix passed seven Linux tests and the live deployment retry.
